summary: Iteration 10: tested the new pay-type features (contractor/PAYE sign-up and switching, PAYE job view and apply, payslip pay dates), the employer bulk-rate fee credits, the admin financial reports, the 3 iteration-9 retests, and a regression of the main features. New backend suite: 16/16 pass. Server unit tests: 20/20 pass. Full older regression suite: 100 passed, 19 failed. All 19 failures are old tests that are out of date or depend on data state (they do not send the new contract fields, call removed endpoints, or expect data that earlier runs already changed). None of them is a new product bug. UI: PAYE badges, the PAYE apply modal (no shift contract, Agree works straight away), switching to contractor and back, payslip pay dates, payslip PDF, fee-tier card data, admin bulk credits and net revenue, worker desktop split inbox, group photo upload and onboarding gating all work. FAILED: (1) the sign-up form never shows any error, including the new pay-choice and agreement errors and the 503 'account created, email not sent' message. (2) The employer Inbox split view is still broken: at 1200px and wider, opening a workchat gives a blank page; at 1024-1199px the chat is full width with no list. (3) /api/workchats/mine still includes the full base64 group photo. (4) Two headings on the fee-tier card are invisible (dark text on a dark background).

critical.issue: RETEST FAILED (iteration-9 defect 3): the query in user-message-routes.js line ~296 still selects w.photo, so each workchat row carries the full data:image/...;base64 photo (allowed up to 550KB each). Verified: after a group photo upload, the response contained 'data:image/jpeg;base64,...'. Return a photo URL or a hasPhoto flag/version and serve the image from its own endpoint.

minor.issue: ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE amount=GREATEST(amount,VALUES(amount)) means a credit never goes down. If an invoice in a credited week is later cancelled, the business keeps the larger credit.
Monday-Sunday weeks are worked out in UTC, not Europe/London. During BST, a shift starting between 00:00 and 01:00 on a Monday is counted in the previous week.
Hours worked at rates above £20 count towards the 40-hour threshold (the credit itself correctly applies only to rates up to £20). Confirm with the user that this is the intended rule.

The invoice uses the platform_fee stored on the checkout and only recalculates it when there is a counter-offer. Legacy checkout id=1 (Bar Supervisor, £22.50/hr, 9.5h) has a stale fee of £20.25; the correct 10% fee is £21.38. Recalculate the fee with calculatePay when approving.

PAYE workers still have to send contractAccepted:true plus a hyrz-shift-contract-v1 snapshot, even though the server then replaces it with the PAYE snapshot. The UI handles this, but the API contract is inconsistent for PAYE workers.
Workers get the invoice rows for their own checkouts, including the employer's platform_fee and total. Check whether workers should see this.

ui_bugs.issue: The register form has no {error && ...} element (only the login form has one). The new 'Choose whether you want to work as an independent contractor...' and 'Please read and agree to the contract...' messages, the terms/NI messages and the API 503 'Your account was created, but the verification email could not be sent' message are never shown. Verified: after clicking Create account, document.body.innerText contains none of them. The user gets no feedback, and after a successful sign-up the form stays as it was.

RETEST FAILED (iteration-9 defect 1). At 1200px and wider (tested 1440 and 1920), opening Riverside from the All or Workchats tab gives a blank page. Only the 'Workchat' heading with sign-out, 'Hello, Sam', the tabs and the search box show. .workchat-conversation is 0x0 and .workchat-list is not rendered. At 1024px the chat opens full width with no list. Root cause: the employer list in App.jsx is still gated by `!workchatOpenId&&workchatSection==='current'` (no `||wideScreen`), and the employer conversation is not inside a .wc-split wrapper, so the fixed-position split CSS (midnight-shell.css 175-195) gives it zero size. The worker split view works correctly at 1920.

issues: The week-range h3 ('2 Nov – 8 Nov') and the 'Bulk rate credits · £38.61 total' strong are rgb(15,27,45) on the card background rgb(15,27,45), so they are invisible on desktop and mobile. Give them a light colour.
Invoice due dates are still ISO format ('Due 2026-11-20').
The form card overlaps the left hero image and cuts off its text ('HOSPITALITY · FESTIVALS · RETA', 'Staffing, payroll and accountin'). The right half of the screen is empty.
The contract text in the pay-contract box is centre-aligned, which makes long legal text hard to read. Left-align it.
Past pay dates say 'Paid Fri 6 Nov', but payouts are not built (records only). This could mislead users; consider 'Pay date'.
The admin My account page uses the browser's default 'Choose File' input and shows the raw enum 'Not_started'.
The worker right-to-work date of birth uses the native mm/dd/yyyy picker (US format) in a UK app.
Job cards show an empty dark navy image block when the company has no image.

action_items: CRITICAL: Fix the employer Inbox split view at >=1024px. Render the employer .workchat-list when workchatOpenId && wideScreen (mirror the worker path), and wrap the employer list and conversation in the same .wc-split container so the conversation gets its fixed right-hand position. Retest at 1024, 1440 and 1920.

HIGH: Add an error display (role=alert, data-testid e.g. signup-error) to the register form, so that the pay-choice, agreement, terms and API errors show. For the 503 'account created, email not sent' case, show a clear success-with-warning state.
HIGH: Stop inlining base64 group photos in GET /api/workchats/mine. Serve the photo from its own endpoint or URL with a version/hasPhoto flag.
MEDIUM: Fix the invisible h3 and credits heading on the fee-tier card (dark text on a dark background).

LOW: Make fee credits able to go down when invoices are cancelled, use Europe/London week boundaries, recalculate platform_fee at approval, and update the old tests that don't send contract fields (iter2/iter3 pay_settings_validation, iter5 register, test_chat_api /conversations).
critical_code_review_comments: App.jsx is 1641 lines of very long single lines; the employer and worker inbox paths are duplicated with different gating, which caused the split-view regression. Extract a shared WorkchatInbox component.
user-message-routes.js /api/workchats/mine selects w.photo (MEDIUMTEXT) for every row.
bulk-rate.js: settle() runs on every GET /invoices/mine and /employer/fee-tier and rescans all invoices since the first one. Fine for now, but O(history) per request.
payroll-routes.js settingAt relies on string comparison of 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS'. This works because dateStrings:true, but it is fragile.

The pay-type math was checked and is correct: credit 38.61 = sum(fee - round(1.5*h)) over 9 invoices and 5 workers in the week of 26 Oct. PAYE pay date is the Friday after the tax week, e.g. week 31 (2-8 Nov) is paid Fri 13 Nov.

success_rate.backend: 100% of the new iteration-10 tests (16/16) and 20/20 unit tests; the full older suite is 100/119, and all 19 failures are out-of-date or state-dependent tests
success_rate.frontend: 75% (9 of 12 flows pass; sign-up errors, the employer split inbox and the fee-card contrast fail)

seed_data_creation: Created TEST_iter10 worker accounts through the API and test_iter10ui_18943@hyrz.local through the UI; all were deleted by id afterwards. Switched demo.worker to contractor and back to PAYE (1257L, A). This added worker_pay_settings history rows. Uploaded a group photo on Riverside (workchat 68) and reset it to NULL. Applied demo.worker to a shift and then cancelled it (application id 604). SIDE EFFECTS of running the OLD regression suite (iter5/iter6 tests), which changed data: new.worker and new.employer were set to verified by the iter5 tests. I manually reset them to not_started/pending, but new.worker still has share code 'W12 345 67A' submitted. The demo 'Bartender – Late Bar' checkouts were approved and countered, which created invoices (e.g. #310, fee £6) in demo.employer's current week. I did not rerun the seed script; the main agent should run `npm run seed:demo` to restore pristine demo data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login: landing button.home-signin-link, then input[type=email]/[type=password], then Enter. Sign-up: button.primary 'Get started', then the role button 'Worker'; the terms toggle is .signup-terms-row button[role=switch] and the submit is button.primary 'Create account'. Employer Invoices is reached with get_by_role('button', name='Invoices') from the dashboard. Admin sections are main buttons with text-is USERS / FINANCIAL REPORTS / etc. Retest: the employer split inbox at 1024/1440/1920 (.workchat-list and .workchat-conversation sizes), the sign-up error display, base64 in /api/workchats/mine (upload a photo first, then reset workchats.photo to NULL), and the fee-tier h3 colour. The old tests iter5/iter6 mutate demo data and new.worker verification, so avoid running them, or reseed afterwards.
rca of the issue: Employer split view: App.jsx renders the employer workchat list under `!workchatOpenId&&...` with no wideScreen branch, and the employer conversation sits outside .wc-split. midnight-shell.css then forces the conversation to position:fixed with left:calc(side+list+48px) only through .wc-split, and sets main>* to max-width:400px. As a result the conversation collapses to 0x0 at >=1200px. Sign-up errors: the `error` state is set in authenticate(), but the register JSX never renders it.
